definitions.short: to be (transitively, do or make ) good (or well) in the widest sense
definitions.usage: be (do) better, cheer, be (do, seem) good, (make) goodly, × please, (be, do, go, play) well.
definitions.full: H2895. tob I. טוֺב verb pleasing, good (Late Hebrew id. , Hiph`il; also derivatives; Arabic , medial , be pleasant, delightful, delicious, sweet or savoury in taste or odour, be pure and clean, cheerful, gleeful (Lane); Aramaic , , טַיֵּב טַב, טְאֵב, and especially derivatives glad, joyful ; Assyrian ‰âbu , be good, kind, acceptable , joyful , vigorous Dl HWB 299 ) — Qal Perfect טוֺב Num 11:18 32 t.; plural טֹבוּ 24:5 ; Song 4:10 ; ( Imperfect יִיטַב from יָטַב ); Infinitive absolute טוֺב Judg 11:25 ; construct טוֺב Jer 32:39 6 t., כְּטוֺב Judg 16:25 Qr (Kt טוב כי ); Participle טוֺב 11:25 ; 1Sam 2:26 ; (for these forms see Bö § 1133, 4 SS under the word; Ges recognizes only Perfects and fewer of them than above. It is often difficult to decide between verb and adjective ); — 1 be pleasant, delightful , of tents of Jacob Num 24:5 (J E; poetry); of caresses Song 4:10 (followed by מִיַּיִן compare) 2 be glad, joyful לֵב טוֺב Judg 16:25 (Qr), 1Sam 25:36 ; 2Sam 13:28 ; Est 1:10 (see טוּב 2c ). 3 of rank, position, claim : מבלק אתה טוֺב הֲטוֺב Judg 11:25 art thou really better than Balak ? 4 לְ טוֺב be well with, good for Num 11:18 (J), Deut 5:30 ; 15:16 ; 19:13 ; 1Sam 16:16 , 23 ; 2Sam 14:32 ; Psa 119:71 ; 128:2 ; Jer 22:15 ; so (that is לוֺ ) Isa 3:10 it is well (with him); טוב אז Jer 22:16 (compare 22:15 ); אֶלֿ טוֺב 1Sam 20:12 there is good toward David 5 be pleasing בְּעֵינֵי טוֺב (see II. טוֺב 2b c f ) Num 24:1 (J) 2Sam 3:19 , 36 ; 15:26 ; 19:38 ; בְּעֵינֵי טוֺב אִם 1Kin 21:2 ; Jer 40:4 , 4 ; Zech 11:12 ; later usage is עַל טוֺב אִם if it seem good unto (so Assyrian ‰âbu eli, be pleasing unto, Dl HWB 300 a ), 1Chr 13:2 ; Neh 2:5 , 7 ; Est 1:19 ; 3:9 ; 5:4 , 8 ; 7:3 ; 8:5 ; 9:13 (compare טוֺב adjective ). Hiph`il Perfect 2masculine singular הֱטִיבוֺתָ 2Chr 6:8 , הֱטִיבֹתָ 1Kin 8:18 ; 2Kin 10:30 ; — do well, act right , followed by כִּי that 1Kin 8:18 thou didst well, that it was in thine heart = 2Chr 6:8 ; followed by infinitive with לְ 2Kin 10:30 thou hast done well in performing what was right in mine eyes.
